prose: Hacker News links to a SynthID Detector site, the public tool Google launched this week to check whether an image, video or audio file carries its SynthID watermark. The synthid.com page itself returned no readable content to this pipeline, so this entry rests on the headline and the Google blog link in the feed.
Basis: headline and feed link. See the TechCrunch coverage of the launch for what the detector supports: dozens of common file formats, and detection tied to Google's own watermarking.
highlights: Checks images, video and audio for the SynthID watermark
Page unreadable to the pipeline; summary from headline and feed
